item.title: Mizoram: Mizoram bars schools from sharing student data with AI platforms without Govt approval
item.description:
The Mizoram School Education Department has issued strict guidelines prohibiting schools from sharing students’ personal information with private agencies, NGOs and third-party artificial intelligence (AI) platforms without prior government approval.
